title: Practice 6: The present for the future, and «let's go»

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Возьми обезьяну и ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.) с нею!
exercises.why: **летай** — imperative (ты, singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.) к ним.
exercises.why: **езди** — imperative (ты, singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.), князь!
exercises.why: **езди** — imperative (ты, singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Заплочено и ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **ездим** — present tense (1st person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: ___ (побежать — to start running; pf., imper. pl.) куда-нибудь? — упрашивал, метаясь на месте, Висленёв.
exercises.why: **побежимте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».

exercises.q: По вечерам мы ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st pl.) гулять.
exercises.why: **ездим** — present tense (1st person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Мы вообразим, что мы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st pl.), что у нас выросли крылья.
exercises.why: **летаем** — present tense (1st person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
